headline: President Bush made another change to the 2005 order that set up an advisory panel to study changes to the federal tax system.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13369, which created the President's Advisory Panel on Federal Tax Reform. That panel was set up to study the federal tax code and suggest ways to change it. The title shows this was a further change to how the panel worked, but no summary was provided. Other records suggest it pushed back the panel's deadline for its report, but the source here does not confirm the details.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Advisory Panel on Federal Tax Reform
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules in the earlier order that set up and guided their work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 30, 2005; no separate start date is given in the source material.
